summary: Iteration 8 — New CSS approach (height:100% chain to .cometchat-list__body) WORKS: scrollHeight=1439 > clientHeight=386, overflowY=auto. Last messages VISIBLE. Auto-scroll after send WORKS. HOWEVER: scroll-up to history is STILL BLOCKED — CometChat resets scrollTop from 0 back to 1053 within 100ms. RCA confirmed: our custom MutationObserver in ChatApp.js fires on every CometChat DOM update and unconditionally resets scrollTop to bottom, preventing any manual scroll-up.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (scroll history): MutationObserver in useEffect fires on every CometChat DOM mutation (receipt updates, online indicators, etc.) and unconditionally calls scrollTop = scrollHeight. This resets scroll position to bottom within ~100ms, preventing user from reading history. Confirmed: JS scrollTop=0 works synchronously (afterSet=0) but is reset to 1053 after 100ms and 1000ms.

rca_of_scroll_up_issue.confirmed_root_cause: ChatApp.js useEffect MutationObserver fires on EVERY CometChat DOM mutation (not just new messages). Observer calls scrollToBottom() unconditionally via requestAnimationFrame. This includes subtle CometChat internal mutations (read receipts, timestamps, online status updates). Result: any user scroll-up is overridden within one animation frame (~100ms).
rca_of_scroll_up_issue.evidence: scrollTop set to 0 synchronously succeeds (afterSet=0). After 100ms: scrollTop=1053 (back to bottom). After 1000ms: scrollTop=1053 still (continuous reset).
rca_of_scroll_up_issue.secondary_factor: CometChat's own scrollToBottomOnNewMessages={true} prop also resets scroll on new messages, but only fires when NEW messages arrive (not continuously). This is expected behavior and not the primary issue.

action_items: HIGH PRIORITY — Fix MutationObserver in ChatApp.js scrollToBottom useEffect: add 'was near bottom' check before scrolling. Only call scrollToBottom() if user was already within 150px of bottom before the mutation. This allows scroll-up to history without breaking auto-scroll on new messages.
VERIFY: After above fix, test that (a) user can scroll up to see older messages, and (b) new messages still auto-scroll when user is at bottom.
OPTIONAL: Consider adding a 'scroll to bottom' floating button that appears when user is scrolled up (common WhatsApp pattern) to provide explicit UX for returning to latest messages.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatApp.js lines 619-629: MutationObserver calls scrollToBottom() unconditionally on every DOM mutation. Must add near-bottom check: const wasNear = s.scrollHeight - s.scrollTop - s.clientHeight < 150; if (wasNear) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(scrollToBottom);
ChatApp.js: The scrollToBottom logic itself targets .cometchat-list__body first — this is correct now and will work when the observer is fixed.
App.css: The height:100% chain is working correctly — .cometchat-list__body achieves sh=1439 > ch=386 with oy=auto. No CSS changes needed.
